orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.basis: Route orbs, grazes and formation chains; only resolved threats award mastery.

stack.title: Stack
stack.basis: Physical placements plus bounded Focus and blueprint bonuses. Low native unit values are upscaled.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.basis: Eight core trials plus three qualified overtime trials; correct choices, latency and clean circuits.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.basis: Active survival plus combo, phase-cut and pickup rewards.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.basis: Timing grades, bounded perfect streaks, wagers and authored paths.

merge.title: Merge
merge.basis: Tile merge values and earned contracts; thinking time alone never earns points.

typerush.title: Type Rush
typerush.basis: Word length, four pressure waves, accuracy chains and priority targets.

oneline.title: One Line
oneline.basis: Collected stars, stage clears, ink/attempt quality and route mastery.

breakout.title: Breakout Mini
breakout.basis: Brick HP, board clears, catches and contracts; later rounds keep contributing.

perfectstop.title: Perfect Stop
perfectstop.basis: Seven sectors plus three qualified Encore sectors; precision and route bonuses.

chain.title: Chain
chain.basis: Bounded per-orb chain factor plus wave clears, conserved charges and Resonance.

gravity.title: Gravity
gravity.basis: Five authored sectors, cores, optional flight contracts and final clear bonus.

blade.title: Laser Blade
blade.basis: Slices, precision cuts, chained targets and wave phrase bonuses.

pinball.title: Neon Pinball
pinball.basis: Bumpers, targets, missions and a capped 5x table multiplier across three balls.

chrono.title: Chrono Wave
chrono.basis: Cleared walls, Focus precision, stages and earned pickups.

matrix.title: Memory Matrix
matrix.basis: Correct sequence steps and timed clears; optional Overclock adds real memory load.

drift.title: Cyber Drift
drift.basis: Fixed 60-Hz active drifting, slower-earned combo tiers, near misses and style routes.

vanguard.title: Galaxy Vanguard
vanguard.basis: Enemy kills, escalating waves, bosses and special threat bonuses.

slingshot.title: Orbital Slingshot
slingshot.basis: Successful captures, launch quality, stardust and completed sector missions.

snake.title: Cyber Serpent
snake.basis: Food, bounded temporary multipliers, growth and firewall mastery.

rhythm.title: Neon Rhythm Tapper
rhythm.basis: Three authored charts loop while Groove survives. Per-chart density normalization, 0.85x Easy / 1x Medium / 1.3x Hard, and continued but diminishing AP after each mastery benchmark.

tower.title: Gravity Tower Jumper
tower.basis: New altitude, precision landings, gems and voluntary Apex risk.

pacmaze.title: Cyber Pac-Runner
pacmaze.basis: Pellets, ghosts, level clears, fruit and optional Hunt Rush.

flappyaero.title: Aero Pulse
flappyaero.basis: Gates, stars, safe grazes and faster optional Flow routes.

roadcross.title: Cyber Crosser
roadcross.basis: New forward rows, coins and district checkpoints; backtracking cannot farm rows.

bubblebuster.title: Orb Cannon
bubblebuster.basis: Matches, detached cascades, earned Burst and salvo contracts.

astroblaster.title: Astro Blaster 360
astroblaster.basis: Asteroid sizes, UFOs and wave-clear bonuses.

laserrope.title: Laser Rope Reflex
laserrope.basis: Successful beam crossings, orbs, Fever, choreography and voluntary Redline.

blockdrop.title: Cyber Block Drop
blockdrop.basis: Drops, line clears, level multipliers, back-to-back and clear chains.

knifetarget.title: Knife Target
knifetarget.basis: Landed blades, apples, Razor marks and escalating stage clears.

airhockey.title: Neon Puck Smash
airhockey.basis: 60-second match. Goal rewards already scale Casual 1x, Pro 1.75x, Master 2.5x.

neonrail.title: Neon Rail Shift
neonrail.basis: Active survival, coins, phase cores and optional faster Surge routes.
